description: This file declares external functions related to patching the RTL826XB PHY chip, including patch application and database initialization. It includes conditional header inclusions based on the Linux environment and provides documentation comments for each function.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch
methods.description: Applies patch data to a specified PHY port based on unit, base port, and port offset.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch
methods.description: Applies patch data to PHY ports in either per-chip or per-bus mode, supporting broadcast updates.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init
methods.description: Initializes the patch database structure for a specified PHY port.
